name: Manoah's wife
title: Samson's mother
summary: Manoah's wife was childless when the angel of the Lord appeared to her and promised that she would give birth to a son who would be a Nazirite and begin to deliver Israel from the Philistines. She gave birth to Samson.

keyEvents.title: Promised a Son
keyEvents.description: The angel of the Lord appeared to Manoah's childless wife and promised that she would give birth to a son who would be a Nazirite from the womb.
